source.source_title: A TRAVELER MEETS AIR TRAFFIC CONTROL
source.why_this_clip: A yellow pencil enters from the upper right and points with its sharpened tip at blips on a dark green radar screen, drifting slightly as the hand holding it moves. The interval runs from the cut at 6.75 s (after the airliner shot and its dissolve) to just before the cut to the control room at 10.5 s.
